description: Deletes one relay from Development, with its run history — the dashboard's own delete, at once, with no approval: Development's events no longer start it. Never Live: a relay Live has stays in Live, and a promote never removes anything from Live — removing Live's is its own request (request_delete_relay), approved by the founder in their browser. put_relay makes it again. On the founder's Logs.
name: dev_delete_relay
title: Development: delete a relay
